database.initialization: Create the database and tables on backend startup when they do not exist.

users.purpose: Application users. The MVP seeds one user with username user.

boards.purpose: The Kanban board owned by a user.
constraints: UNIQUE(user_id) enforces one board per user for the MVP

columns.purpose: Fixed board stages whose titles may be renamed.
constraints: UNIQUE(board_id, position) keeps column order deterministic
UNIQUE(board_id, id) keeps column identifiers scoped to a board

cards.purpose: Cards displayed inside a board column.
constraints: UNIQUE(column_id, position) keeps card order deterministic
A card must reference a column belonging to the same board

relationships: users 1-to-1 boards for the MVP, modeled as users 1-to-many for future expansion

delete_behavior.column: RESTRICT while cards exist; move or delete cards before removing a column

user.storage: Store only a password hash in the database; the literal MVP password is used only by the seed/setup path.

api_mapping.board_response: Return columns ordered by position, with cards nested in each column ordered by position.
api_mapping.create_card: Insert cards with the next position for the selected column.
api_mapping.move_card: Update column_id and normalize positions in the source and destination columns.
api_mapping.delete_card: Delete the card and normalize positions in its column.

implementation_notes: Use parameterized SQL for all queries.
Use transactions for moves and other operations affecting more than one row.
Do not store the frontend cardIds array; derive ordering from cards.column_id and cards.position.
